sources_read: .qc-cache/kittle-2026-10-09-r9/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx :: Quality Checks row 3 (instruction_is_spelled_right_and_uncontaminated); Internal Quality Checks row 3; Deterministic Checks check-instruction-content.py / check-instruction-hygiene.py
evidence: Frozen instruction.md (sha 57c87d33...) and the three /instructions notes (hashes match manifest) were read in full. A full unique-word extraction across all four files found no misspellings (proper nouns Kittle, Rowe, Pryce, Lloyd, Anand, Marsh are consistent with seed accounts/firm). grep for TODO|FIXME|XXX|CHANGE_ME|TBD|<placeholder>|C:\|/Users/|/home/|F:/|turing-workspace|judge|rubric|criteri|claude|playwright|/tests|probe returned only the two legitimate product uses of the word 'placeholder' (conversations.md:9, walls-and-retention.md:35, describing the deleted-message placeholder). Template stub 'CHANGE_ME: write the task prompt...' was fully replaced. No non-ASCII/control characters, no CRLF, no duplicated paragraphs, no author asides. Contradiction sweep: one clock value only (integration.md:7 2026-05-12T11:00:00Z = seed clock = server.js CLOCK); one seed path (/assets/seed_data.json, instruction.md:5 and integration.md:5, matches Dockerfile 'COPY assets/ /assets/'); one account list (walls-and-retention.md:5-11 equals the 5 seed accounts/roles); one password (password123, = server.js:17); timer options off/1/7/30 = seed timer_options_days [null,1,7,30]; 'Dev Anand is walled from M-12' = seed M-12 walled [dev@kittle.test]; port 3000, DB_PATH and /app/app.db consistent between instruction.md:5 and integration.md:3; signed-out behaviour consistent (instruction.md:7, integration.md:9); deleted-with-replies placeholder rule consistent (conversations.md:9, walls-and-retention.md:25,35). The deliberate typo 'Landlords notice recieved.' exists only as a seed earlier-version body for K-2 (realistic edit history), not in the instruction. Weak-app/conforming-alternative probe: this row grades brief text only; no text defect found that would mislead a conforming build or let a broken build pass. Deterministic halves (check-instruction-content/hygiene) were applied manually as greps, not executed as the private checker.
